editorial: We flew. The flight is short but the combination of a small aircraft, elevation and wind produced memorable turbulence in both directions.
legs.title: Santa Cruz to Sucre

editorial: Overnight buses left around 9:00 PM and reached Uyuni in the early morning when we travelled. The seats reclined reasonably well, but it was still a long, stuffy ride.
Check your exact terminal with locals before departure. This is one of those places where blindly trusting the map nearly cost us the trip back.
legs.title: Sucre to Uyuni
